prompt:
An ivy-covered stone pub on a village street corner at dusk, slate roof against a deep blue sky, warm light in every window, a lantern on each side of the front door, an old street lamp glowing on the left, the empty road across the foreground. A very slow, smooth push in toward the front door. The lamplight in the windows and lanterns flickers softly; a thin low mist drifts slowly across the road from left to right; the ivy leaves barely stir. No other movement. Same building, same light, the street empty, the picture clean. Quiet, photographic, cinematic dusk.
Thanks.
